settings.title: Settings
settings.openHelp: When closed, the page stays visible but nobody can vote or suggest.

official.empty: No official mods yet. Add one, or promote a suggestion.
official.removeBody: The mod and its votes are deleted. It can be added or suggested again later.

add.title: Add a mod to the official list
add.lede: Pick it from Modrinth or CurseForge, or add it by hand if it’s on neither.
add.name: Name

suggestions.lede: Sorted by score. Removing a suggestion hides it and its votes, and tells the person who suggested it why.

events_home.description: The next event and the agenda on the front page.

jobs_deleteInactive.description: The nightly deletion of accounts with no sign-in for 24 months.

jobs_pruneAvatars.description: The removal of photos no account uses.

jobs_closeStaleSessions.label: Close stale Warden sessions
jobs_closeStaleSessions.description: The check that closes Warden sessions with no heartbeat.

events_registration.description: Registering, joining the waitlist and cancelling. Pages stay, and managers can still add and remove people.

events_imageSearch.description: SteamGridDB in the event image picker. Uploads and links keep working.

push.description: Sending notifications and the prompt to allow them. Settings stay visible but off; queued notifications wait.

push_subscribe.description: The prompt after a registration and the switch in the account settings. Devices already allowed keep receiving.

push_newEvents.description: Announcing a new event to followers. Nothing is queued while this is off.

push_reminders.description: Reminders before events people registered for.

push_spots.description: The notification when a place opens, or a manager adds someone.

jobs_pushPrune.label: Prune notification log
jobs_pushPrune.description: The nightly removal of notifications older than 90 days and of dead devices.

team.label: Team page
team.description: The public team page and its footer link. Admins can still manage the team.

team_join.label: Join the team button

partners.label: Partners page
partners.description: The public partners page and its footer link. Admins can still manage the partners.

partners_contact.description: The “Want to support LNB?” band at the bottom of the partners page. The saved link stays.

shortLinks.label: Short links
shortLinks.description: The /go/ links. Visitors see that the link is off. Admins can still manage them.

shortLinks_tracking.description: Links keep counting clicks but stop recording who clicked. People already recorded stay.

rooms.name: Name

types.empty: No event types yet. Add the first one to create events.

form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: Short is better: the BDE website prints it very large.
form.descriptionHelp: Markdown: **bold**, lists and links. No images.
form.endsAtHelp: Filled in as start + 3 hours. Change it if needed.
form.parisTime: Paris time, whatever your device says.
form.schoolsHelp: Everyone can see the event. Only these schools’ students can register.

form.closesAtHelp: Optional. Empty: when the event starts.
form.priceHelp: Whole euros, paid on site. Empty: free.
form.draftHelp: Only events managers can see a draft. Turn it off to publish the event.

errors.name: Give the event a name, up to 120 characters.
errors.description: Describe the event in a few words.
errors.roomId: Pick a room, or add one.
errors.capacity: Use a whole number of places, from 1.
errors.registrationOpensAt: Use a full date and time, or leave it empty.
errors.registrationClosesAt: Use a full date and time, or leave it empty.
errors.price: Use whole euros, from 0 to 1000, or leave it empty.
errors.endsBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
errors.closesAfterStart: Registration must close before the event starts.
errors.opensAfterClose: Registration must open before it closes.
errors.bdeName: For the BDE website, the name needs 3 to 100 characters.
errors.bdeDescription: For the BDE website, the description needs at least 10 characters.

form.embedEmpty: Pick the image Discord, X and the BDE website show for this event.
form.sameEmbedHelp: Turn it off to pick another image for Discord, X and the BDE website.
form.bdeSync: Publish on the BDE website too
form.bdeSyncHelp: Its S’inscrire button sends students here. A draft stays hidden there, and a cancelled event comes down.
form.bdeOff: Not set up: the site needs the token the BDE office gives (BDE_API_TOKEN).
form.remindersHelp: Sent to registered people only, before the start. Pick as many as you need, or none.

registrations.removeWaitlistBody: They leave the waitlist. They aren’t told: let them know if needed.
registrations.addLede: Registers an account by hand, whatever its school or the registration window.
registrations.forceHelp: The event goes over its limit by one place.

picker.focusLede: Step 2 of 2. Click the part of the image that must always show: every crop is centered on it.
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search a game, such as Minecraft
picker.bannersHelp: Banners are 1920 × 620, the exact shape of the event banner.
picker.coversHelp: Covers are narrower: the banner keeps a band of them.
picker.noArt: No art of this kind for this game. Try the other tab, or another game.
picker.fileHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB. Wide images work best.
picker.dropHelp: Or click to choose a file.
picker.linkHelp: An https link to an image. The site downloads it once and never loads it from there again.
picker.pickLedeNoSearch: Step 1 of 2. Upload an image, or paste a link to one.

push.concerned: {audience} people are concerned. The others have this kind of notification off, or no device.

push.name: Name

push.capHelp: Only used for warnings and counts. It never blocks a notification.
push.loadFailed: The notifications overview couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
push.empty: Nobody has turned notifications on yet.
push.quietHelp: While on, a new-event announcement sent during the quiet hours waits for their end. Reminders, waitlist places, cancellations and moves are never held. Turn it off to send announcements at any hour.

team.title: Team
team.note: People appear on the public team page with their name, school and profile photo. Ask for their agreement before adding them.
team.empty: No pole yet. Add the first one, such as the bureau.
team.noMembers: No member in this pole yet.

join.title: Join link
join.help: Where the “Join the team” button leads, such as a form or a Discord invite. It must start with https://. Leave it empty to hide the button.
join.label: Link
join.flagOff: The button is switched off in the feature flags.

pole.featuredHelp: It becomes the large band at the top of the page. Only one pole is featured.
pole.deleteLede: Only an empty pole can be deleted.

member.bioHelp: Optional. Shown under the name on the featured pole.

errors.poleNotFound: This pole no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.memberNotFound: This member is no longer on the team. Reload the page.
errors.alreadyMember: This account is already on the team.
errors.hasMembers: Move or remove the members of this pole first.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

partners.title: Partners
partners.note: Partners appear on the public partners page with their logo, description and link. Every partner needs a description.
partners.empty: No partner yet. Add the first one.
partners.noneInKind: No partner of this kind yet.

contact.title: Contact link
contact.help: Where the “Get in touch” button leads: an https link, or a mailto: address. Leave it empty to hide the band.
contact.label: Link
contact.flagOff: The band is switched off in the feature flags.

partner.name: Name
partner.descriptionHelp: What they do for LNB. A French text left empty shows the English one.
partner.urlHelp: Optional. It must start with https://.
partner.logoHelp: PNG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB. It is shown on a light plate, so dark logos work best.

errors.partnerNotFound: This partner no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.logoNotFound: The logo is gone. Upload it again.
errors.imageTooLarge: This file is too large. Logos can be up to 1 MB.
errors.imageUnreadable: This file isn’t a PNG, WebP or SVG image we can use.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

partners.deleteLede: The partner and its link disappear from the partners page. This can’t be undone.

shortLinks.title: Short links
shortLinks.note: A short link sends people from /go/lan-party, for example, to another page. It can count clicks, ask people to sign in, or stay inside some schools.
shortLinks.empty: No short link yet. Create the first one.
shortLinks.deleteLede: The link stops working and its click history is deleted. This can’t be undone.

form.destinationHelp: Where people end up. It must start with https://.
form.shortIdHelp: Letters, numbers and dashes. Leave it empty to get a random one. It can’t change later.
form.name: Name

any.label: Anyone
any.description: No sign-in. Clicks are counted, nothing else.

signed.label: Signed-in students
signed.description: Asks people to sign in, then redirects.

schools.label: Some schools only
schools.description: Signed in, and from the schools you pick.

form.recordHelp: Keeps the name and school of each signed-in person who opens it. The sign-in page tells them.
form.recordNeedsSignIn: Needs sign-in. Without it LNB only counts clicks.
form.recordFlagOff: Switched off in the feature flags.
form.enabledHelp: When off, the link shows a page saying it doesn’t work.

summary.any: Anyone with the link can open it, signed in or not. Clicks are counted, nobody is identified.
summary.signed: Anyone signed in with an allowed school account can open it. Everyone else is asked to sign in first.
summary.schools: Only students of {schools} can open it. Others see a page that says so.

detail.title: Link
detail.trackingOff: Recording who clicks is switched off in the feature flags, so new clicks are counted without names.
detail.shown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Only admins see this list.
detail.hintAny: Anyone can open this link without signing in, so LNB only counts clicks. To see who clicked, require sign-in and turn on “Record who clicks”.
detail.hintEnable: Turn on “Record who clicks” in Edit to see which people opened this link.

errors.shortLinkNotFound: This link no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.shortIdTaken: This short link is already used. Pick another one.
errors.failed: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.

players.search: Search by name, email or Minecraft username
players.empty: No players match. Try another name, or clear the filters.
players.loadFailed: The players couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

appeals.empty: No appeals waiting. New ones show up here.
appeals.responsePlaceholder: Explain your decision to the player
appeals.needResponse: Write a response for the player first.

activity.empty: Nothing yet. Changes show up here as they happen.

actions.limitReset: Account limit back to the default
actions.uuidCollision: {username} kept its old UUID: the offline one is already linked

settings.maxAccountsHelp: How many Minecraft accounts each player can link. A player’s own limit wins over this one.

player.siteAdminOnly: Only site admins can change the Warden admin role.
player.unlinkBody: Its playtime and sessions are deleted, and it’s kicked from the server if it’s playing.
player.regenerateBody: Their current address stops working right away, and they’re disconnected if they’re playing. They’ll find the new one on their Warden page.
player.roleOnBody: They can ban, unban and warn players from here and in-game, and see the activity log.
player.loadFailed: This player couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

banModal.title: Ban {name}
banModal.lede: The ban covers every Minecraft account they’ve linked, and replaces their current ban.
banModal.never: Never ends. Only an admin can lift it.
banModal.pickDate: Pick when the ban ends, in the future.

limitModal.title: Account limit for {name}
limitModal.lede: How many Minecraft accounts this player can link. Accounts already linked stay linked.

errors.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.notFound: This player or ban doesn’t exist anymore. Reload the page.
errors.notBanned: This player isn’t banned anymore. Reload the page.
errors.appealClosed: Another admin already answered this appeal. Reload the page.
errors.notLinked: This account isn’t linked anymore. Reload the page.

mods.title: Mod list
mods.lede: Vote on the mods for the LNB Minecraft server, and suggest the ones you want to see. The Minecraft team picks the official list.
mods.officialLede: These mods are on the server. Your votes tell the Minecraft team what to keep.
mods.loadFailed: The mod list couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
mods.bannedNotice: You’re banned from the Minecraft server, so you can’t vote or suggest mods until the ban ends.

empty.official: The official list is empty for now. The Minecraft team adds mods here.
empty.suggestions: No suggestions yet. Suggest the first mod below.

vote.own: You can’t vote on your own suggestion
vote.banned: You can’t vote while you’re banned from the Minecraft server

search.label: Mod
search.empty: No mods match. Try another name, or check the spelling.
search.sources: Results come from Modrinth first. Mods that aren’t on Modrinth come from CurseForge.

suggest.title: Suggest a mod
suggest.lede: It must run on {loader} {version}. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left.
suggest.reasonHelp: Your name and reason are shown with the suggestion.
suggest.reasonPlaceholder: What it adds to the server, and who it’s for.
suggest.panelLeft: You’ve used all your suggestions. Withdraw one to suggest another mod. | Suggest it and everyone can vote on it. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left. | Suggest it and everyone can vote on it. You have {left} of {max} suggestions left.
suggest.panelSignedOut: Sign in to suggest a mod and vote on the list.

reason.title: Edit your reason for {name}
reason.lede: The votes stay as they are.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {name}?
withdraw.body: Your suggestion and its votes are deleted. You can suggest another mod in its place.

errors.closed: Voting and suggestions are closed for now.
errors.banned: You can’t do this while you’re banned from the Minecraft server.
errors.ownMod: You can’t vote on your own suggestion.
errors.limitReached: You’ve used all your suggestions. Withdraw one to suggest another mod.
errors.duplicate: This mod is already in the list. Vote on it instead.
errors.removed: The Minecraft team removed this mod from the suggestions, so it can’t be suggested again.
errors.incompatible: This mod doesn’t run on the server’s Minecraft version and loader.
errors.notFound: This mod isn’t in the list anymore. Reload the page.
errors.notSuggestion: This suggestion was already handled. Reload the page.
errors.notOfficial: This mod isn’t in the official list anymore. Reload the page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.manual: Mods added by hand have no source to refresh from.
errors.sourceUnavailable: Modrinth and CurseForge can’t be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.

toSuggestions.title: Don’t see the mods you like?
toSuggestions.body: Members suggested 1 more mod. Vote on it, or suggest your own. | Members suggested {count} more mods. Vote on them, or suggest your own.
toSuggestions.bodyEmpty: Members can suggest more mods. Be the first to suggest one.

spot.title: A place opened for you
spot.body: You have a place at {name} on {date} at {time}.

cancelled.title: Cancelled: {name}
cancelled.body: The event on {date} no longer takes place.

prompt.title: Stay in the loop on your events
prompt.intro: We only send notifications about events. No ads, no news. About 3 a week at most.
gets: A reminder before an event you registered for
A place opens for you on a waitlist
An event you’re on is cancelled or moved
prompt.enabled: Notifications are on for this device
prompt.snoozedDays: We won’t ask again for {days} days. You can turn notifications on in your account.
prompt.snoozedNever: We won’t ask again. You can turn notifications on in your account.
prompt.denied: Notifications weren’t allowed. You can change that in your browser’s site settings.
prompt.failed: Notifications couldn’t be turned on. Check your connection, then try again from your account.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.intro: Only about events. No ads. About 3 a week at most.

newEvents.label: New events
newEvents.description: When the BDE announces an event

spots.label: Waitlist places
spots.description: When a place opens for you, or a manager adds you

settings.adminSees: Admins can see that you turned notifications on.
settings.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in the site settings of your browser, then come back here.
settings.ios: On iPhone, add LNB to your home screen first: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open LNB from its icon to turn notifications on.
settings.unsupported: This browser can’t receive notifications. Try another browser or device.
settings.disabled: Notifications are switched off for now. Your choices are kept.
settings.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection, then try again.
settings.notConfigured: Notifications aren’t set up on this server yet. Ask an admin to add the push keys.

team.title: The LNB team
team.lede: Students from Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG who run the evenings, tournaments, IRL games and the Minecraft server. Come say hi at the next event.
team.empty: The team will show up here soon.

join.title: Want to help run LNB?
join.lede: Tell us what you would like to work on.

partners.title: Our partners
partners.lede: The companies and studios that help LNB run evenings, tournaments and IRL games.
partners.empty: Our partners will show up here soon.

sponsor.name: Sponsors
sponsor.lede: They give us money, equipment or food, so evenings and tournaments can happen.

game.name: Game partners
game.lede: Studios and publishers who give us game keys for prizes and giveaways.

prize.name: Prize partners
prize.lede: Brands that give gifts for tournament winners and giveaways.

contact.title: Want to support LNB?
contact.lede: Tell us what you can offer and we will find the right fit: prizes, food, equipment or game keys.

signIn.title: Sign in to open this link
signIn.any: This link is for students of Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG.
signIn.schools: This link is for students of {schools}.
signIn.recorded: LNB records that you opened it.

wrongSchool.title: This link isn’t for your school
wrongSchool.yours: You are signed in with your {school} account.

off.title: This link doesn’t work any more
off.body: It was turned off, or the address has a typo. Ask the person who shared it for a new one.
